requirements.quote:
close_notify:  This alert notifies the recipient that the sender will
      not send any more messages on this connection.  Any data received
      after a closure alert has been received MUST be ignored.
requirements.required_behavior: send no more messages on that connection
requirements.why_checkable: The sender's post-alert state can reject subsequent message writes.

requirements.quote:
close_notify:  This alert notifies the recipient that the sender will
      not send any more messages on this connection.  Any data received
      after a closure alert has been received MUST be ignored.
requirements.condition: data is received after a closure alert
requirements.forbidden_behavior: deliver or process data received after the closure alert
requirements.why_checkable: Injected post-closure records can be checked for non-delivery and non-processing.

requirements.quote:
user_canceled:  This alert notifies the recipient that the sender is
      canceling the handshake for some reason unrelated to a protocol
      failure.  If a user cancels an operation after the handshake is
      complete, just closing the connection by sending a "close_notify"
      is more appropriate.  This alert SHOULD be followed by a
      "close_notify".  This alert generally has AlertLevel=warning.
requirements.why_checkable: The emitted alert sequence can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Each party MUST send a "close_notify" alert before closing its write
   side of the connection, unless it has already sent some error alert.
   This does not have any effect on its read side of the connection.
requirements.condition: closing the write side without having sent an error alert
requirements.required_behavior: send close_notify before closing the write side
requirements.forbidden_behavior: close the write side before close_notify
requirements.why_checkable: The transport-close and alert ordering is observable.

requirements.quote:
Each party MUST send a "close_notify" alert before closing its write
   side of the connection, unless it has already sent some error alert.
   This does not have any effect on its read side of the connection.
requirements.condition: close_notify is sent and the read side remains open
requirements.why_checkable: Reads can be verified to remain available after write-side closure.

requirements.quote:
If the application protocol using TLS provides that any data may be
   carried over the underlying transport after the TLS connection is
   closed, the TLS implementation MUST receive a "close_notify" alert
   before indicating end-of-data to the application layer.  No part of
requirements.condition: the application protocol permits transport data after TLS closure
requirements.required_behavior: receive close_notify before indicating end-of-data to the application
requirements.why_checkable: The close-alert and application EOF ordering can be tested to detect truncation.
